split.strategy: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) over deterministic SHA-256 group IDs of the complete feature vector; test partition = fold 0
split.guarantee: all rows sharing one exact feature vector belong to exactly one partition; train/test exact-vector overlap is hard-checked to be 0

conflicting_labels.policy: reported, never silently resolved: whole vector groups are kept intact inside one partition; StratifiedGroupKFold assigns mixed-label groups first and accounts for their label distribution
